from pathlib import Path
import os, json, fcntl, runpy, time, statistics
from dataclasses import asdict
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.low_thrust import ScvxSettings, solve_leg, certify_leg

fixture = runpy.run_path('tests/test_gtoc12_gpu_discretisation.py')
reference_mass = 2445.3111007852112
rows = []
variants = [('numpy', 'numpy', 'clarabel'), ('cuda', 'cuda', 'clarabel'), ('cuda', 'cuda', 'qoco')]
with Path('/home/angus/.spacepdhcg-gpu.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    for repeat in range(6):
        # Rotate order to reduce systematic order bias; record every attempt.
        for i in range(3):
            dynamics, assembly, solver = variants[(i + repeat) % 3]
            settings = ScvxSettings(discretisation_backend=dynamics, assembly_backend=assembly,
                convex_solver_backend=solver, qoco_ruiz_iterations=0, hold='zoh',
                max_iterations=30, time_limit_s=30)
            start = time.perf_counter()
            solution = solve_leg(fixture['synthetic_boundary'](), settings)
            seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
            certificate = certify_leg(solution)
            qualified = bool(solution.converged and certificate.within_tolerance
                and abs(solution.final_mass_kg - reference_mass) <= 1e-5)
            row = dict(repeat=repeat, warmup=repeat == 0, settings=asdict(settings),
                seconds=seconds, status=solution.status, mass=solution.final_mass_kg,
                fixed_reference_mass=reference_mass, mass_error=solution.final_mass_kg-reference_mass,
                qualified=qualified, certificate=asdict(certificate),
                iterations=solution.iterations, accepted=solution.accepted_iterations,
                history=solution.history, reports=solution.solver_reports)
            rows.append(row)
            Path('artifacts/performance/gtoc12-qoco-v94-benchmark.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2)+'\n')
            print(repeat, dynamics, assembly, solver, qualified, seconds, row['mass_error'], flush=True)
    for dynamics, assembly, solver in variants:
        selected=[r for r in rows if not r['warmup'] and r['settings']['discretisation_backend']==dynamics
            and r['settings']['assembly_backend']==assembly and r['settings']['convex_solver_backend']==solver]
        print('SUMMARY', dynamics, assembly, solver, sum(r['qualified'] for r in selected), '/', len(selected),
            'median_attempt_seconds', statistics.median(r['seconds'] for r in selected), flush=True)
